free_tier.stated: 50 GPU hours a month, free, every month, on a dedicated 24GB VRAM slice of an RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell; the allowance is wall-clock metered while the slice is provisioned, renews monthly and does not carry over. Marked 'Coming Soon'.
free_tier.notes: Not open yet: the page reads 'Coming Soon' and carries a waitlist, and the Run sign-up page says sign-up is not available yet. A month is 730 hours, so the allowance is 50 of them.

retention.stated: Persistent storage is included with the server; a free slice that sits idle is warned and then reclaimed, and free slices are preemptible.

egress.terms: Not stated for the free tier: the page publishes no egress allowance and no egress price, so nothing is known to be charged per gigabyte and nothing is promised free.

interface_detail: SSH with root and Docker on a dedicated GPU slice; no console, API or CLI is documented for the free tier.
tooling: an SSH client and Docker; the one-click images ship Open WebUI + Ollama, vLLM and JupyterLab + PyTorch.
chaining: 50 hours a month on a 24GB Blackwell slice is a fine-tuning and inference bench; because a free slice is preemptible and reclaimed when idle, a job that must survive reclamation needs its checkpoints written to a separate object-storage record.

limits.value: 50 GPU hours a month, wall-clock metered while the slice is provisioned; usage past 50 hours is billed at EUR 0.49 per GPU hour

limits_note: Free slices are preemptible with no SLA, and a slice that sits idle is warned and then reclaimed. One account per person; free hours do not stack or carry over between months.
binding_note: The 50-hour monthly allowance is what runs out first: it is 50 of the 730 hours in a month, and past it the meter runs at EUR 0.49 a GPU hour.

identity_cost.detail: The Run sign-up form asks for first name, last name, email and password; the free tier requires a EUR 0 card check or a 1-cent iDEAL verification from a non-disposable card, with no charge and no subscription. The general Leafcloud cloud signup is a separate flow that asks a EUR 2 downpayment and a EUR 200 GPU deposit, and the free-tier page does not say whether the free tier inherits it.

reliability_note: Free slices are preemptible with no SLA and an idle slice is warned then reclaimed; the vendor states it may end the freemium model at any time, and the tier is marked 'Coming Soon' with sign-up not yet available.
confidence_note: The quota, the 24GB slice, the overage price, the card check and the preemption terms are quoted from the vendor's free-tier page read on 2026-11-06; the 'Coming Soon' state is on the same page and the disabled sign-up is in the Run sign-up page's own text.
